body:
## Code Review

This pull request introduces a bounded local observability dashboard for the 9709 beta readiness posture and queue priority, including the dashboard JSON, validator results, a markdown readback file, a generator script, and Jest tests. The review feedback suggests a performance optimization in the generator script to replace linear array scans with Set lookups when filtering missing metric IDs and boundaries, reducing lookup complexity from O(N * M) to O(N + M).
